title: The Shema in the RSV: one God, and the command to recite it
summary: The RSV of Deuteronomy 6:4-9 states the Shema: one God, to be loved and recited to the children.
body: In the Revised Standard Version, Deuteronomy 6 opens the Shema by naming the Lord as one and telling Israel to love that God and to recite the words. The wording on the page includes: "CCB CCBT ERV-ZH CNVS CNVT CSBS CSBT CUVS CUV CUVMPS CUVMPT RCU17SS RCU17TS Update 4 “Hear, O Israel: The Lord our God is one Lord;[a] 5 and you shall love the Lord your God with all your heart, and with all your soul, and with all your might. 6 And these words which I command you this day shall be upon your heart; 7 and you shall teach them diligently to". The evidence label is the truth-gate ceiling for this host. The host is not on the gate's primary-text or official list, so the label is weak. The quotation is still the page's wording.
